description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English
The unique ID of the gateway.

description.zh: 是否获取所有K8s集群（false时只获取未被关联的集群）。
description.en: Specifies whether to obtain the information about all Kubernetes clusters. If you set the value to false, only the information about unassociated clusters is obtained.
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse get-kubernetes-source --gateway-unique-id gw-c5d1aadb7df646cfb7065fbf75c10000 --vpc-id vpc-bp1t50e045b5g7i3p0000 --is-all true --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse GetKubernetesSource --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-c5d1aadb7df646cfb7065fbf75c10000' --VpcId 'vpc-bp1t50e045b5g7i3p0000' --AcceptLanguage zh --IsAll true
